readout_other: Multisite intracranial single/multi-unit recordings (32-channel NeuroNexus microelectrodes) from S1, POm and auditory cortex; RSU/FSU spike classification; directional spike-time tiling coefficient (dSTTC) analysis
direction_notes: High PRF (>=1,500 Hz) with mid-range duty cycle selectively excited S1 regular-spiking units and synchronized POm activity (feedback modulation), while 30 Hz PRF produced an inhibitory S1 response; both time-locked and ~200 ms delayed (feedforward) responses were parameter dependent.

exposures.label: tFUS targeting S1, varying PRF and duty cycle

timing.protocol_description: Each trial used a 67 ms ultrasound duration with a 2.5 s intersonication interval (10% jitter), 500 trials per parameter, and randomized order of stimulation conditions. PRF (30-4,500 Hz) was swept at a constant 200 us pulse duration; duty cycle (0.6-90%) was separately swept at fixed 3,000 Hz and 30 Hz PRF, with pulse duration in that sweep calculated from PRF x DC rather than stated directly.

source_quotes.n_subjects: To explore the neuronal responses in the CTC pathway to tFUS, multiunit activities were recorded from the S1 and POm (N= 16).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The customized 128-element random array ultrasound transducer H276 (f0: 1.5 MHz, −3 dB axial specificity: 1.36 mm and lateral specificity: 0.46 mm, manufactured by Sonic Concepts) was used in our experiments.
source_quotes.exposures[0].free_field.pressure_kpa: Using parameters of 1,500 Hz PRF, 200 μs pulse duration (PD), 67 ms ultrasound duration (UD), and 5 V input voltage achieved the spatial peak pressure of 1,626.4 kPa in free water without beam steering.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.pressure_kpa: The measured peak-to-peak in situ ultrasound pressure magnitude with beam steering (targeting S1) was 88 kPa (Fig. 1C) and spatial-peak temporal average (I ) was 29.42 mW/cm2.
source_quotes.exposures[0].in_situ.ispta_w_cm2: The measured peak-to-peak in situ ultrasound pressure magnitude with beam steering (targeting S1) was 88 kPa (Fig. 1C) and spatial-peak temporal average (I ) was 29.42 mW/cm2.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_duration_ms: For the PRF efect exploration, the pulse duration (PD) was set at 200 μs for all the PRFs.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The PRFs that were tested in this work contained 30, 300, 1,500, 3,000, and 4,500 Hz.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: We tested five levels of DCs as we used in the PRFs exploration: 0.6, 6, 30, 60, and 90%.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: In our study, the intersonication interval (ISI) was set at 2.5 s for each trial with 10% jitter and the ultrasound duration (UD) was kept at 67 ms for each condition.

flags.reason: Only the in-situ spatial-peak temporal-average intensity (Ispta, 29.42 mW/cm2) is reported for the calibrated beam-steered condition; an in-situ Isppa value is not given, so it is left not_reported.
Group sizes are reported separately for the main CTC-pathway cohort (N=16) and a second cohort used only to test for auditory confound (N=12); the paper never states a combined total.

The paper does not use an active auditory-masking method; instead it recorded from auditory cortex (a separate N=12 cohort) to test whether AC neurons responded to tFUS, finding low-PRF (30 Hz) tFUS produced an auditory confound while high-PRF (3,000 Hz) did not. Coded as 'other' since this is a confound analysis rather than a listed control method.

'Randomised' here refers to randomisation of the order of stimulation parameter conditions within subjects ('The order of stimulation conditions was randomized'), not random allocation to separate treatment/control groups.

The 200 us pulse duration is stated as constant for the PRF-effect exploration; for the separate duty-cycle exploration the paper states pulse duration was calculated from PRF x DC but does not give the resulting discrete values, so only the 200 us value is recorded.

A third condition -- ~170 kPa used only for target-confirmation trials before recording -- is described in Methods but is not part of the recorded 500-trial stimulation parameters, so it is not included in the pressure fields; see protocol_description.
